title: Knight's Gear
wikitext:
{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Knight's Broadsword Icon.png |caption= A Knight's Broadsword |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= [[Soldier's Gear]] |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Knight's Gear|Knight's Gear|BotW, AoC, Series}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Knight's Gear was equipment issued to the [[Hylian Knight]]s who guarded [[Hyrule Castle]]. It is known for its reliability and [[Durability]], qualities for which it still sees use in the wake of the the [[Great Calamity]].{{Cite|{{Big|Knight's Broadsword}}
Knights of Hyrule once carried this sword. These days it's the weapon of choice for seasoned adventurers thanks to its ease of use and high attack power.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Knight's Claymore}}
Only the most confident of Hyrule Castle's knights carried this two-handed sword. Its cutting edge is finely honed.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Knight's Bow}}
The sturdy metal construction of this bow offers superior durability, while its lack of firing quirks makes it quite reliable. Once favored by the knights at Hyrule Castle.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Knight's Shield}}
A shield favored by the knights who served the Hyrulean royal family. Its sturdy metal construction makes it quite durable, but its weight requires decent skill to wield.|Inventory|BotW}} All pieces of Knight's Gear are made of metal, which means they will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Finally, they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. There is also Knight's Gear equipment available for [[Horse]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}} This [[Horse Gear]] was used by the Hylian Knights to protect their Horses and as status symbols.{{Cite|{{Big|Knight's Bridle}}
Hyrulean knights once outfitted their horses with this bridle. It boasts additional armor to protect the horse's head and neck.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Knight's Saddle}}
Hyrulean knights favored this saddle. Only the most elite among them were allowed to outfit their mounts with it.|Inventory|BotW}} The [[Knight's Bridle]] can be obtained by breaking 20 to 22 [[Target]]s during the [[Horseback Archery]] [[Mini-Game]].{{Cite|Tell you what... You break {{Color BotW|Red|more than 20}} targets, and I'll hand over my {{Color BotW|Red|horse gear}}.|Jini|BotW}}{{Cite|Hm...{{Color BotW|Red|[X] targets}}... You've got some fire in you, young man. The best archers say {{Color BotW|Red|targets seem to freeze when they concentrate on them}}. I think you could reach that level too. Here's a gift to help you on your travels. Hope you find a good use for it.|Jini|BotW}} The [[Knight's Saddle]] can be obtained by breaking 23 to 25 Targets.{{Cite|Hm...{{Color BotW|Red|[X] targets}}... It's been a dog's age since I've seen such talent in someone so young. What do you mean you're not that young? Over 100 years old? Go ahead, pull the other one. Anyway, this gift is my thanks for putting on a good show.
